name: Runhua Living Service Group Holdings Limited
summary: Runhua Living Service Group Holdings Limited, founded in 1996 and headquartered in Jinan, is an investment holding company providing property management in China. Its four segments are property management, property engineering and landscape construction, leasing from investment properties, and others. Services include cleaning, security, repairs, hospital property management, elevator installation, parking, housekeeping and software support, plus intermediary services for patient nursing and post-natal care.
